message: キスはノーカン、恋はノーコン

name: Nanaka
message: 「Mornin'!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hm, what's wrong? You're looking down.」
Nanaka doesn't seem any different.

name: Synn
message: 「M-Morning.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I get feeling gloomy 'cause of the test and all, but you gotta at least fake some energy!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y...eah. You're right.」
Does she not care?

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sigh... Even so, man, I really hate tests.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y...eah.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hmph. Now do you finally understand the pain of us below-average folks, Synn?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well... I wouldn't go that far.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Grr. Look at you, totally unfazed.」
She's just like she always is.

name: Synn
message: 「I mean, it's not like I ever liked tests in the first place. I wouldn't mind if we didn't have them.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Is that how it is.」
I see. That really must have been an accident.
I mean, we're talking about Nanaka here.
She probably just leaned in to check on me while I was passed out, and then.
Still, Nanaka and I... we kissed...
That fact tightens around my chest.
Ever since then, this awkward atmosphere has just lingered on.
Normally, I should be the one to bring it up and apologize, but.
I can't say it... Nanaka is just acting way too normal.
Maybe Nanaka's acting like nothing happened because she's so kind.
Still, that makes me feel kind of lonely in its own way.
To Nanaka, I'm just a childhood friend...
Our relationship isn't fragile enough to fall apart over a mere kiss...

name: Synn
message: 「About yesterday... sorry.」

name: Synn
message: 「For suddenly sitting up like that back then.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A... Aah, that thing... That was, yeah... well...」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, because we kissed...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Uuu--\s03 Don't say it out loud, it's embarrassing, you know!\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sorry」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Because we kissed... Synn's worrying this much... All because of me...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Forcing it really wasn't a good idea, huh... Anyway, I have to cheer Synn up」

name: Nanaka
message: 「But even so... telling him straight out is too embarrassing...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「H-Hey, Synn! Don't get all depressed over something like that」

name: Synn
message: 「Eeeh!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Th-That was... how should I put it, u-um...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That was an accident! Can't be helped, can't be helped!」

name: Synn
message: 「An acci... dent...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Man, things straight out of a drama really do happen in real life!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So, it's nothing you need to apologize for, Synn」
Nanaka suddenly stops in her tracks.
And then, an index finger was thrust right in front of my nose.

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That never happened. Got it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh... but」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Both you and I are gonna forget about this. If the two of us forget it, it means it never happened」

name: Synn
message: 「I can't just--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It doesn't count! That wasn't a k-kiss! It was an accident!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah... I guess so」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Right!」
Nanaka started walking again, her shoulders strangely squared.

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-It was my first kiss... though」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaa?! I-It was?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Forget it! Both just now and yesterday! And while you're at it, forget about studying for the test too! Just forget everything!」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Okay」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even though I... won't ever be able to forget it for the rest of my life...」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka...?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sigh... Now we're right back to square one...」
